## ✨ Highlights

- **Website and docs** — HarnessKit now has a website at [harness-kit.dev](https://harness-kit.dev), with full documentation in English and Chinese (#181, #182, #183).
- **Shift+click range select** — in the Extensions table, shift+click selects every row between two checkboxes (#178).
- **Bug fixes** — Antigravity skills and MCP servers now go to `~/.gemini/config/`, the folder the App, the IDE and the `agy` CLI all read (#179); a skill with a quoted frontmatter name no longer appears twice after the 1.15.1 upgrade (#177).
